name: Weixin
tagline: (WeChat) is an instant messaging, social media, and mobile payment app developed by Tencent.
description: Weixin (WeChat) is an instant messaging, social media, and mobile payment app developed by Tencent.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/weixin:version-f1376de7@sha256:200f4b7ed2bb29c6d366e804b8cbea5f7030d7a20f38e11cfeb03e23a6ad79d5
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
